definition: For most people before mass schooling, education meant learning a craft or household economy by doing, with literacy rare and economically optional.

"bucket.foundation reforms education. It is the operating system a person runs inside from the first year of school to the research frontier: a map of foundations, a workspace where a learner finds, quotes, checks, and organizes evidence, and a path where a student's own production enters the map as a citable contribution that outlives the term it was written in." Also: "Bucket is where a person learns to produce knowledge, starting on day one."

"to be "educated" is not to have been trained or to have acquired information, but to have been **initiated into worthwhile activities and forms of knowledge** in a manner that one comes to value for their own sake, with breadth of understanding and "cognitive perspective"". Three criteria: it transmits something worthwhile, involves knowledge and understanding, and engages the learner's willing understanding.

Education is "**growth through experience**"; it "has no end beyond itself except *more growth*: the test of an experience is whether it leads to further fruitful experience, governed by the principles of **continuity** and **interaction**".
"*Schooling* is an institution; *training* is the acquisition of a specific competence; *education*, on most accounts, is something broader and harder to pin down, A formation of the whole person."
"a distinction between three functions of education to which I refer as qualification, socialisation and subjectification" (abstract).
"education always functions in relation to three domains of purpose: qualification, socialisation and subjectification" (abstract).
"subjectification has to do with the existence of the child or student as subject of her or his own life, not as object of educational interventions" (abstract).
Argues the main function of education is to certify intelligence, work ethic and conformity, and that students forget most of what they learn.

"education, therefore, is a process of living and not a preparation for future living" (Article II); "education must be conceived as a continuing reconstruction of experience; that the process and the goal of education are one and the same thing" (Article III).

"It is that reconstruction or reorganization of experience which adds to the meaning of experience, and which increases ability to direct the course of subsequent experience." (ch. 6). Also: "the educational process has no end beyond itself; it is its own end" (ch. 4).

Freire contrasts a 'banking' model, where the teacher deposits content in passive students, with problem-posing education in which teacher and students inquire together into their world. Paraphrase; no quotation was verified.
Democratic equality, social efficiency and social mobility compete, and the growth of the mobility goal turns education into a private good.
Asks what each person is able to do and to be, and judges development by real opportunities instead of GDP.

The framework sets individual and collective well-being as the aim and defines student agency as the capacity to set a goal, reflect and act responsibly to effect change. Wording from search snippets of the OECD student agency page.
Education is treated as initiation into worthwhile activities with knowledge, understanding and voluntary participation as criteria.
Human capital theory is economistic and instrumental; the aim of policy should be to expand people's capabilities.
Development is treated as the expansion of the real freedoms people have, with education as one of the social opportunities that build capability. Paraphrase; no quotation was verified.
Education can raise wages by signalling pre-existing ability to employers even if it adds no productivity.

Education is defined as the processes by which societies deliberately transmit their accumulated information, knowledge, understanding, attitudes, values, skills, competencies and behaviours across generations; it involves communication designed to bring about learning.
"Education shall be directed to the full development of the human personality and to the strengthening of respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms." (Article 26.2).

The single reusable unit of knowledge: a markdown file with id, branch, shell, type, requires, unlocks, equation, mastery_signal, sources, canon_ref and art_prompt, holding a Feynman-level explanation, the formal statement, a worked example and 2-4 quiz prompts.
The Posterior Analytics "gives the first theory of *demonstrative knowledge*: scientific knowledge is knowledge of *causes*, organized as deductions from first principles."

"The **canon** is the small set of buckets that have been judged to contain *foundations*, axioms, real math, rules, laws, principles, primary derivations, across seven branches". "Outcomes ... are *applications* of foundations. They live downstream of the canon".

Founder's words in bead ros-truth epic: "A claim's standing depends on how it is known: seen and touched first-hand, reported first-hand by someone else, second-hand, recorded on video, read, derived, or proven. Tiers also depend on falsifiability, theoretical versus experimental support, whether the claim asserts existence or non-existence, and the data behind it."

The catalog is a DAG of concepts with a mandatory-prerequisite relation; a knowledge state is a set K of concepts, closed when every immediate prerequisite of a member is a member; a concept outside K is ready, on the frontier, when all its prerequisites lie in K.
Reliance on the word of others is a basic source of knowledge and cannot be reduced to perception, memory and inference.
Two cases show a person can hold a justified true belief without knowing, so the three conditions are not sufficient.
A belief is justified when it is produced by a process that tends to produce true beliefs.
Polanyi argues that people know more than they can tell and that skilled knowing rests on particulars the knower cannot fully state. Paraphrase; no quotation or page was verified.
Intelligent performance is a kind of knowledge that does not reduce to holding propositions.
"Learning is L = J_p(t + 7 d) - H_p(t + 7 d): at the retest, the score on items first seen with the model minus the score on items first seen alone, both unaided".

"Five levels of interaction with the graph, each holding the ones before it: Access ..., Awareness (where knowledge can go from here), Understanding (learning the node itself), Internalization (the learned node meets the rest of the graph), Production (a new node, built from the nodes you hold and placed among them)." The workspace "never writes the answer".
Performance during acquisition is an unreliable index of learning; some manipulations raise one and lower the other, and learners misread fluent performance as learning.
An atom is mastered when every required signal level reaches BKT P(mastered) ≥ 0.95 and its FSRS stability exceeds a floor, so mastery means retained and not once-correct.
Current mastery is accepted evidence for present readiness; historical attainment records earlier achievement; unknown means unassessed and supplies no positive evidence.
Per concept, fuse proficiency P = σ(a(θ−b)) at its lower confidence bound with FSRS retrievability R at a fixed horizon such as 90 days: M = P^α · R^β, aggregated as a weighted geometric mean.

Twelve correct server-scored independent items across at least two forms and two sessions seven days apart, no hints, evidence at most 30 days old; the 95% Wilson lower bound exceeds 0.75 for 12 of 12.
Mastery of an atom is retrieval at increasing depth: recall or cloze, apply to a new instance, derive from prerequisites, teach back.
"mastery is their product": M = P^alpha R^beta with P = sigma(theta - b_apply), b_apply = -0.2, R = R(90, S), alpha = beta = 1, clipped to [0, 1]; "a concept counts as mastered at M >= 0.7".

A scientist understands a phenomenon when they can build a qualitative explanation from an intelligible theory without the full calculation; intelligibility shifts historically with tools and training.
Prediction accuracy alone does not count as understanding; a human must be able to internalize and independently apply the pattern the AI found.
Knowledge has less distinctive value than assumed; understanding, a grasp of how a body of information fits together, is the more valuable state.
Understanding is the ability to think and act flexibly with what one knows, shown through performances such as explaining, applying and generalizing, with stated goals and ongoing assessment.
